title: Yakitori-Style Japanese Chicken Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired chicken dish made with chicken breast, roasted yellow peppers, and a touch of sweetness from the yakitori sauce. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner or lunch.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together yakitori sauce, soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Thread the chicken, roasted yellow peppers, and green onions onto skewers.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot with additional yakitori sauce for dipping, if desired.
